title: genetyllis thymoides
intro: Genetyllis thymoides, commonly known as Thymophylla, is a genus of flowering plants in the daisy family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Genetyllis thymoides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Genetyllis thymoides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
